title: Majority stable influence and noise stability
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $0<\delta<1$. The stable influence at parameter $1-\delta$ and leading coordinate of the function on $2m+2$ coordinates formed by multiplying the leading coordinate by majority on $2m+1$ coordinates equals the noise stability of majority on $2m+1$ coordinates at parameter $1-\delta$.
